OoO roster aggregates are sourced from the dated 2026-09-29 screenshot import. comparison_policy: Do not calculate cross-alliance trend rates from different-date baselines. Null alliance data means not available. Violation counts require verified agreements and exception rules. Sum castle/member data only where numeric fields exist, and mark partial coverage. OoO power uses alliance ranking power, other roster-derived power totals may use rounded member figures.
